newsitem.title: USA: Maui Land & Pineapple Q3 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Maui Land & Pineapple Q3 net falls.

text.p: Three months ended Nine months ended

NOTE: The Company's reports for interim periods utilize numerous estimates of production, general and administrative expenses, and other costs for the full year. Consequently, amounts in the interim reports are not necessarily indicative of results for the full year.

Net income for the third quarter and first nine months of 1995 includes $5.7 million ($3.18 per share) and $3.2 million ($1.78 per share) of income attributable to the reversal of the Company's equity in losses of a partnership investment. These losses were reversed in the third quarter of 1995 because the Company disposed of its partnership interest in October 1995.
